briefing: NASDAQ (-0.7%) and S&P 500 (-0.6%) both slipped modestly today, a neutral-to-slightly-negative session with no clear risk-on catalyst. None of today's top candidates showed the full four-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, RSI 55-70, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge) our strategy memory requires for high-conviction buys, so we're holding our $589 cash and all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors pull back from riskier assets amid uncertainty, causing broad indexes to dip modestly even without major bad news. The disciplined response is to hold steady rather than chase trades, since forcing a buy without strong confirming signals increases the odds of an early loss.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「risk-off」(規避風險)日子是指投資者在不確定氣氛下減少持有風險較高的資產,即使沒有重大壞消息,大市指數也會溫和下跌。紀律性的做法是按兵不動,而非勉強進場,因為在缺乏強力訊號確認下買入,提高了初期虧損的機會。

market_education.summary_en: Markets drifted lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.7% and S&P 500 down 0.6%, a mild pullback rather than a sharp risk-off move. No single dominant catalyst stood out, consistent with a session of profit-taking and consolidation after recent gains. Without a strong directional signal, staying disciplined and avoiding forced trades is the more prudent approach.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍偏軟,納斯達克指數下跌0.7%,標普500指數下跌0.6%,屬溫和回調而非明顯的risk-off走勢。市場未見單一主導因素,較似是近期升勢後的獲利回吐及整固。在缺乏明確方向訊號下,保持紀律、避免強行進場屬較穩妥做法。
